title: Frequently Asked Questions
summary: Here are some frequently asked questions about me and my work. If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact me.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer comprehensive web development services, ranging from Full Stack application development to UI/UX Implementation, Technical SEO, Backend & API Integration, and Database Management.

faqs.question: What are your proficient technologies?
faqs.answer: I am proficient in modern JavaScript frameworks like React.js and Next.js, backend technologies including Node.js and Python, as well as HTML, CSS, Scss, Bootstrap, MySQL, MongoDB, Technical SEO, Schema Markup, and ADA Compliance.

faqs.question: What are you familiar with?
faqs.answer: I am familiar with Advanced JavaScript, PHP, and integrating third-party systems like ATS, CRM, and VMS platforms.

faqs.question: What tools do you use?
faqs.answer: I use Git & GitHub for version control, VS Code and Visual Studio Code as my primary editors, and Postman for API testing.

faqs.question: What are your soft skills?
faqs.answer: My soft skills include Problem Solving, Communication, Teamwork & Collaboration, Time Management & Organization, and Adaptability & Learning.

faqs.question: What is your current role?
faqs.answer: I am currently a Software Engineer - Full Stack Developer at United Health Care Staffing, where I build scalable web applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Python. I also handle database management and API integrations.

faqs.question: What kind of projects have you worked on?
faqs.answer: I have worked on a variety of web development projects, ranging from e-commerce platforms to healthcare staffing portals and lead generation tools. Examples include Byzfunder, ThePhix, and internal dashboards for staffing operations.

faqs.question: Do you have experience with Backend Development?
faqs.answer: Yes, I develop secure backend APIs using Node.js and Python and manage databases like MySQL and MongoDB to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.

faqs.question: Do you work with Technical SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes, I implement technical SEO best practices, schema markup, and performance optimizations to enhance search engine visibility and drive organic traffic.

faqs.question: Are you available for freelance projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, I am open to new opportunities and collaborations, including freelance projects. Please feel free to reach out to me through the contact form.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can contact me by filling out the contact form on this website, or through my social media links in the footer.

faqs.question: What is your approach to web development?
faqs.answer: I focus on creating responsive, accessible, and optimized web applications. I enjoy collaborating with teams to transform project requirements into high-quality, user-friendly interfaces.

faqs.question: Do you have experience with accessibility (ADA Compliance)?
faqs.answer: Yes, I have experience in ensuring that web pages and web applications are accessible to people with disabilities by adhering to ADA Compliance Standards.

faqs.question: Can you describe your experience with front-end development?
faqs.answer: I am a proficient Full Stack Developer with strong skills in React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I specialize in creating responsive and accessible user interfaces.

faqs.question: What is your experience with UI development?
faqs.answer: As a UI Developer, I focus on creating user-friendly interfaces and transforming Figma/PSD designs into pixel-perfect, interactive web pages. I ensure a seamless user experience across all devices.

faqs.question: Have you worked with any content management systems (CMS)?
faqs.answer: Yes, I have collaborated with teams working on various platforms, including WordPress and Shopify, providing high-quality HTML and SCSS to build modern and responsive websites.

faqs.question: What is your experience with email marketing?
faqs.answer: I have experience creating and testing responsive email templates for marketing campaigns using tools like Litmus and Mailchimp to ensure cross-platform compatibility.

faqs.question: Can you provide examples of your freelance work?
faqs.answer: Yes, I have worked on freelance projects such as OneTouchGrade and Job Crafter. You can find more details in the projects section of my portfolio.

faqs.question: What is your approach to teamwork and collaboration?
faqs.answer: I am a collaborative team player and believe in open communication. I have experience working with designers, developers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality web applications.

faqs.question: How do you stay updated with new technologies?
faqs.answer: I am committed to continuous learning and staying up-to-date with industry trends. I actively learn new technologies like Python, Node.js, and Next.js to drive innovation.

faqs.question: What is your experience with design tools?
faqs.answer: I am familiar with design tools like Figma and have experience converting Figma designs into clean, semantic, and responsive HTML code.

faqs.question: What is your experience with version control?
faqs.answer: I use Git and GitHub for version control to manage my code, collaborate with team members, and track changes effectively.

faqs.question: What is your experience with React?
faqs.answer: I have extensive experience building responsive and user-friendly web applications with React.js and Next.js. I develop reusable UI components, manage state, and optimize performance.

faqs.question: How do you ensure your websites are responsive and mobile-friendly?
faqs.answer: I have a strong focus on responsive web design for both desktop and mobile. I use modern CSS techniques like Flexbox, Grid, and Bootstrap to create layouts that adapt to any screen size.

faqs.question: What is your approach to website optimization and performance?
faqs.answer: I optimize website performance by writing clean code, implementing lazy loading, optimizing images, and using best practices to ensure fast loading times and a smooth user experience.

faqs.question: Can you work with APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes, I have extensive experience developing and integrating secure APIs. I work with JSON-based APIs to fetch and display data and integrate third-party services like ATS and CRM systems.
